description.narrative: The first UNESCO’s Global Sport Policy Survey was developed to enhance global understanding of sport policies, investments and governance, and inform the development of tailored tools and resources to support Member States in advancing inclusion, equity and safety in sport. The data collected will feed into the Global Sport Policy Brief, which will provide a an assessment of inclusive, equitable and safe sport and physical education policies. By aligning findings with UNESCO’s Global Policy Standards, the brief will identify strengths and gaps, and feature recommendations to improve policy design, implementation and evaluation. It will support Member States in developing Fit for Life National Action Plans and strengthening the impact and effectiveness of investments in sport and physical education.
